content.answer_markdown: The post-trade Suitability outcome shows a breach due to the single-position limit rule. Specifically, the position in Exxon Mobil Corp (XOM) is 11.25% of the portfolio, exceeding the 10% single-position limit. All other suitability rules pass, including maximum equity share, sector concentration, minimum cash reserve, client restrictions, horizon check, and taxable-gain warning.
